Special COUNCIL AGENDA 10 May 2024 (1.07 MB)

Traditional Owners

The Goreng people are the Traditional Owners of this land. They have cared for Country for thousands of years, holding deep cultural, spiritual, and historical connections to the area. We acknowledge and pay our respects to the Goreng Elders past and present, and recognise their continuing connection to land, waters, and community.

Special Council Meeting 2 August 2022

Tuesday, August 2, 2022 - 12:00 PM

SPECIAL MEETING OF COUNCIL

 

Pursuant to Section 5.25(1)(g) of the Local Government Act 1995 and Regulation 12(4) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, Public Notice of a Special Meeting of Council is hereby given.

 

THE SPECIAL MEETING WILL BE HELD

 ON TUESDAY, 2 AUGUST 2022

 AT THE SHIRE OFFICE, COUNCIL CHAMBERS,

28 YOUGENUP ROAD, GNOWANGERUP, WA 6335

 COMMENCING AT 12:00PM

 

The purpose of the meeting will be to discuss the 2022-2023 Annual Budget:

  • Valuations and general rates for 2022-2023 Annual Budget
  • Rate concessions for 2022-2023 Annual Budget
  • Minimum payment for 2022-2023 Annual Budget
  • Specified area rates - Gnowangerup Sporting Complex for 2022-2023 Annual Budget
  • Specified area rates – Ongerup effluent system for 2022-2023 Annual Budget
  • Waste collection rate for 2022-2023 Annual Budget
  • Payment of rates options and interest charges for 2022-2023 Annual Budget
  • Imposition of fees and charges including rubbish removal charges for 2022-2023 Annual Budget
  • 2022-2023 Budget statement of financial activity and materiality threshold
  • Adoption of 2022-2023 Annual Budget

 

 

Bob Jarvis

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Special Council Meeting 13 April 2022

Wednesday, April 13, 2022 - 05:00 PM

SPECIAL MEETING OF COUNCIL

 

Pursuant to Section 5.25(1)(g) of the Local Government Act 1995 and Regulation 12(4) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, Public Notice of a Special Meeting of Council is hereby given.

 

THE SPECIAL MEETING WILL BE HELD

 

ON WEDNESDAY, 13th APRIL 2022

 

AT THE SHIRE OFFICE, COUNCIL CHAMBERS,

28 YOUGENUP ROAD, GNOWANGERUP, WA 6335

 

COMMENCING AT 5:00PM

 

 

The purpose of the meeting will be the VARIATION TO THE MEDICAL CONTRACT FOR THE PROVISION OF MEDICAL SERVICES FOR THE SHIRE OF GNOWANGERUP.

The discussion of this matter will be closed to members of the public as the item is considered confidential pursuits to Section 5.23(2)(c) of the Local Government Act 1995 as a contract will be entered into or which may be entered into as the result of this item.

 

  

 

Bob Jarvis

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

We acknowledge and pay our respects to the Goreng Elders past and present, and recognise their continuing connection to land, waters, and community.

Traditional Owners

The Goreng people are the Traditional Owners of this land. They have cared for Country for thousands of years, holding deep cultural, spiritual, and historical connections to the area. We acknowledge and pay our respects to the Goreng Elders past and present, and recognise their continuing connection to land, waters, and community.
